body: The mesh below reaches 2.0 on x and -0.5 on y deliberately. A mesh at the origin would have min [0,0,0], which is the one bound that reads correctly whether or not the scale is applied, so an origin-only probe passes against the defect this pins.

author: reek
body: A substring search rather than a full-document compare: the assertion is about the two bounds, and pinning the whole document would go red for any unrelated field and hide which one moved.
